QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Happy'?
Explanation: 'Glad' means the same as 'Happy'. When you feel glad, you feel happy and joyful!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Big'?
Explanation: 'Large' means the same as 'Big'. An elephant is big — it is also large!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Fast'?
Explanation: 'Quick' means the same as 'Fast'. A cheetah is fast — it is also very quick!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Pretty'?
Explanation: 'Beautiful' means the same as 'Pretty'. A flower is pretty — it is also beautiful!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Sick'?
Explanation: 'Ill' means the same as 'Sick'. When you feel sick, you feel ill and need rest!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Small'?
Explanation: 'Tiny' means the same as 'Small'. An ant is small — it is also tiny!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Start'?
Explanation: 'Begin' means the same as 'Start'. When a race starts, it also begins!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Sad'?
Explanation: 'Unhappy' means the same as 'Sad'. When you feel sad, you feel unhappy!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Shout'?
Explanation: 'Yell' means the same as 'Shout'. Both mean to say something in a very loud voice!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Shut'?
Explanation: 'Close' means the same as 'Shut'. When you shut the door, you close it!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Tired'?
Explanation: 'Sleepy' means the same as 'Tired'. When you are tired after playing all day, you feel sleepy!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Smart'?
Explanation: 'Clever' means the same as 'Smart'. A clever student always gets good marks!

QuestionText: Which word means the SAME as 'Look'?
Explanation: 'See' means the same as 'Look'. When you look at something, you are also seeing it!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Hot'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Hot' is 'Cold'. Fire is hot, and ice is cold!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Day'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Day' is 'Night'. The sun shines during the day, and the moon glows at night!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Big'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Big' is 'Small'. An elephant is big, but an ant is small!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Up'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Up' is 'Down'. You go up the stairs and come down!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Fast'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Fast' is 'Slow'. A cheetah is fast, but a turtle is slow!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Happy'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Happy' is 'Sad'. When you smile, you are happy; when you cry, you are sad!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Clean'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Clean' is 'Dirty'. Your hands are clean after washing and dirty after playing in mud!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Open'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Open' is 'Shut'. You open a box to look inside and shut it to close it!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Light'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Light' is 'Dark'. The room is light with the lamp on and dark when switched off!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Tall'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Tall' is 'Short'. A giraffe is tall, but a rabbit is short!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Old'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Old' is 'New'. Grandpa's watch is old, but the one in the shop is new!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Hard'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Hard' is 'Soft'. A rock is hard, but cotton candy is soft!

QuestionText: What is the OPPOSITE of 'Full'?
Explanation: The opposite of 'Full' is 'Empty'. A bottle full of water is full; after drinking it all, it is empty!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Bat'? (Bat and ___)
Explanation: Bat and Ball go together — you need a ball to play cricket or baseball with a bat!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Salt'? (Salt and ___)
Explanation: Salt and Pepper are always found together on a dining table. They are a famous food pair!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Bread'? (Bread and ___)
Explanation: Bread and Butter go together — you spread butter on bread for a yummy snack!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Lock'? (Lock and ___)
Explanation: Lock and Key go together — you need a key to open a lock!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Pencil'? (Pencil and ___)
Explanation: Pencil and Eraser go together — when you make a mistake with a pencil, you use an eraser!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Cup'? (Cup and ___)
Explanation: Cup and Saucer go together — a cup is placed on a saucer to catch any drips!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Needle'? (Needle and ___)
Explanation: Needle and Thread go together — you thread a needle to sew clothes!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Shoes'? (Shoes and ___)
Explanation: Shoes and Socks go together — you wear socks on your feet before putting on your shoes!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Thunder'? (Thunder and ___)
Explanation: Thunder and Lightning go together — in a storm, you hear loud thunder and see a flash of lightning!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Moon'? (Moon and ___)
Explanation: Moon and Stars go together — at night, you see the moon surrounded by many twinkling stars!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Table'? (Table and ___)
Explanation: Table and Chair go together — you sit on a chair when you eat at a table!

QuestionText: Which word goes BEST with 'Bow'? (Bow and ___)
Explanation: Bow and Arrow go together — a bow is used to shoot an arrow, just like Robin Hood!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Apple, Mango, Carrot, Banana
Explanation: Apple, Mango, and Banana are all fruits. Carrot is a vegetable, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Lion, Tiger, Rose, Elephant
Explanation: Lion, Tiger, and Elephant are all animals. Rose is a flower, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Red, Blue, Happy, Green
Explanation: Red, Blue, and Green are all colours. Happy is a feeling, not a colour, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Dog, Cat, Chair, Fish
Explanation: Dog, Cat, and Fish are all animals. Chair is furniture, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Run, Jump, Swim, Beautiful
Explanation: Run, Jump, and Swim are all action words (verbs). Beautiful is a describing word, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Monday, Tuesday, Apple, Friday
Explanation: Monday, Tuesday, and Friday are all days of the week. Apple is a fruit, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Circle, Square, Ball, Triangle
Explanation: Circle, Square, and Triangle are all shapes. Ball is an object, not a shape, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Mango, Milk, Juice, Water
Explanation: Milk, Juice, and Water are all drinks. Mango is a fruit you eat, not a drink, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Eyes, Ears, Nose, Table
Explanation: Eyes, Ears, and Nose are all parts of your face. Table is furniture, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Rain, Snow, Sun, Chair
Explanation: Rain, Snow, and Sun are all types of weather. Chair is furniture, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? Hen, Duck, Rose, Parrot
Explanation: Hen, Duck, and Parrot are all birds. Rose is a flower, so it does not belong!

QuestionText: Which word does NOT belong? One, Two, Cat, Three
Explanation: One, Two, and Three are all numbers. Cat is an animal, so it does not belong!
